description: NaRb₂Nb₆P₃O₂₄ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2 space group. Rb is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Rb-O bond distances ranging from 3.10-3.41 Å. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are four shorter (2.48 Å) and two longer (2.49 Å) Na-O bond lengths. There are three inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two equivalent PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-35°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.13 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 4-36°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.16 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form NbO₆ octahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra and corners with two PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 5-36°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.14 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-41°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 39-41°. There are two shorter (1.54 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are thirteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Nb atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Na, one Nb, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Nb, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 2-coordinate geometry to one Rb, one Nb, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Nb atoms. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two Nb atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Nb atoms. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Rb and two Nb atoms. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to two equivalent Rb and two equivalent Nb atoms. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent Nb atoms. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one Nb and one P atom. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Nb, and one P atom.
